description:
Install a custom commercial SSL certificate for the virtual server 'acmecorp.test'.

You have been provided with three files in '/home/ga/Documents/ssl_certs/':
1. 'acmecorp.key' (The Private Key)
2. 'acmecorp.crt' (The SSL Certificate)
3. 'ca_bundle.crt' (The Intermediate CA Bundle)

Your goal is to configure the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server in Virtualmin to use these specific files for its website SSL configuration. Navigate to Server Configuration > SSL Certificate > Update Certificate and Key, and install these files. Ensure the CA bundle is included so the trust chain is complete.
